keyPoints: Dharti par jeevon me bahut vividhata hai — hare-bhare paudhe, daudte janwar, rengte keede-makode, udte pakshi aur aankh se na dikhne wale sukshm jeev sab isi vividhata ka hissa hain.
Jeev jahan rehte hain use aawas (habitat) kehte hain — ghana jungle, sukha registan, thanda pahad, talab aur gehra samudra sab alag-alag aawas hain jahan alag jeev rehte hain.
Har jeev apne aawas ke hisaab se dhal jaata hai; jaise unth registan me paani bachata hai, machhli paani me galphadon se saans leti hai aur dhruviya bhalu mote far se thand se bachta hai.
Sthal par rehne wale paudhon ki jaden gehri hoti hain taaki paani sokh saken, jabki paani me rehne wale paudhon ke tane khokhle aur halke hote hain taaki wo tair saken.
Jeevon ko pehchanne ke liye unke lakshan dekhe jaate hain — pankhon ka hona, khaal ka khurdura ya chikna hona, tane ka majboot hona ya gati karne ka tareeka.
Vividhata ko samajhne se humein prakriti ka santulan aur har jeev ki ahmiyat samajh aati hai; ek bhi prajati khatm ho to poore tantra par asar padta hai.
Aam galti: sirf bade janwaron ko jeev samajhna; keede, keenchue, kavak aur sukshm jeev bhi poore jeev hain aur prakriti me unki bhoomika bahut badi hai.

title: Jeev Jagat me Vividhata
